## Unified List email verifier
**Manual only. Keep inactive.**

1. **Domain = column N** (your REGEXEXTRACT formula). Rows with `#N/A`, a free-mail domain (gmail etc.) or filled P-R are skipped. **N is never written.**
2. **Generate:** representatives from Sunbiz + Customer 360. Patterns in order: first.last, first, flast, firstlast, firstl, first.l. A pattern seen in an existing email (or learned earlier for the domain) is used directly.
3. **Location guess:** from the business name ("of Boca Raton", "(DeFuniak Springs)") or a city slug in the website path, e.g. `bocaraton@`.
4. **Test:** one at a time, stop at the first safe hit, reuse the pattern for other reps. If Reacher says catch-all / unknown / no MX, stop testing that domain and put best guesses in Q.
5. Max **10 checks per run**, 5 s apart. Writes O-R only.
